interpretation.current_points_test_size: All current own curve points in this frozen snapshot have 20480 fresh pairs, not a million.
interpretation.diagnostic_comparison: COF parent and derivatives share the same262144-input label. The observed failure reduction is exploratory. Fresh20480-input audits qualify the final derivatives separately.
interpretation.nonce_policy: Published frontier-levers notes retain inherited nonces and deny new nonce/padding search. This does not erase upstream selection. Earlier t0009 inherited an identity-tail nonce; a58-attempt launch was excluded and the clean generator removed the tail.
interpretation.screen_selection: Each real-setting variant gets one hash-derived9024-shot screen. The paper must disclose successful and failed variants. A passing screen does not reduce the true failure rate.
interpretation.neighbor_scope: No measured fresh exact-current-neighbor reliability is available for all current points. Do not generalize the older Leapfrog comparison to the whole public frontier.
